name: zutil_zrdr_next_wildcard_path
description: zUtil_ZRDR::NextWildcardPath advances the in-place wildcard digit odometer and returns the next expanded path until overflow.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; defer to a coherent zReader/ZRDR source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a6070 validates odometer-style digit increment from wildcard slot zero upward, carrying 9 to 0, returning null after overflow, rewriting wildcard bytes from highest tracked slot down through sprintf("%d"), and returning the stored wildcard path on success.
The native smoke verifies single-wildcard increment to 9 and overflow, two-wildcard carry from 09 to 10, no-wildcard behavior, and the shared state created by InitWildcardPath.
